# Natively supported apps

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-apps-doc.py from crates/rustv-shell/src/catalog.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

RusTV ships **42 app tiles**. Each one opens the real service in its own window with a persistent profile, so you sign in once. Nothing is scraped or re-hosted: the app is the service's own website or the Windows program.

Apps you add yourself (custom tiles) and apps provided by mods are not listed here. To add one to the built-in catalog, see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).

**Tested** means someone checked it on a real account or device and the note says what exactly. Most services need an account or subscription, so "Not tested yet" does not mean broken: please report what you find.

## Built into RusTV (not apps)

Live TV (M3U/XMLTV, played with mpv), the local media library, a file browser, Windows settings shortcuts (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, sound, displays, power) and universal search.
